integrated_multimodal_description:

[Shot 1]

Live-action, cinematic ancient Chinese suspense style, presented in a 16:9 widescreen composition.

A medium-wide shot establishes a crowded wooden inn at night.

Warm lanterns illuminate drifting steam, wooden tables, traveling merchants, and rain-streaked lattice windows.

A young female swordswoman with long black hair tied in a high ponytail sits alone at a corner table.

She wears a dark-green fitted robe, black leather bracers, and a sheathed sword at her waist.

A silent waiter places a ceramic wine cup in front of her.

The camera slowly pushes in as she studies the wine without drinking.


[Shot 2]

At 00:02.000, the camera cuts to an extreme close-up of the wine cup.

The female swordswoman removes a silver hairpin and lowers its tip into the clear wine.

As she lifts the hairpin, the immersed silver tip rapidly turns black.

Her fingers stop moving.

The surrounding inn ambience becomes muffled while a single drop of wine falls back into the cup.


[Shot 3]

At 00:03.800, the shot cuts to a tight side view.

The female swordswoman sharply knocks the poisoned wine cup away with the back of her hand.

At the same instant, a crossbow bolt flies from off-screen and strikes the airborne cup.

The ceramic cup shatters in front of the camera, scattering wine and fragments across the table.

She ducks beneath the bolt while the camera shakes strongly with the impact.


[Shot 4]

At 00:05.600, the camera cuts to a low-angle shot of the inn's second-floor balcony.

A masked assassin wearing a black hood and dark cloth armor lowers a compact crossbow.

The assassin turns and vaults over the balcony railing toward an open window.

The camera pans right with large amplitude at fast speed as the black figure disappears into the rain outside.


[Shot 5]

At 00:07.800, the shot cuts back to the female swordswoman.

She rises from the table, draws her sword in one fluid motion, and runs toward the open window.

The camera tracks beside her at fast speed as frightened guests move out of her path.

She leaps through the window into the rain-covered alley.

The camera rapidly pulls out, revealing the swordswoman pursuing the masked assassin across the tiled rooftops.

A flash of lightning freezes both figures in silhouette at 00:10.000.


overall_soundscape:

Low inn conversation, clinking bowls, crackling firewood, and steady rain establish the opening environment.

The silver hairpin touches the cup with a faint metallic ring, followed by rushing fabric, a crossbow snap, shattering ceramic, frightened gasps, a sword leaving its scabbard, rapid footsteps, wind, and a final thunderclap.


non_diegetic_music:

Sparse guqin notes and a low sustained bowed-string drone begin at a slow tempo.

Rapid wooden percussion enters when the crossbow bolt strikes the cup, building into fast war-drum beats before ending sharply with the lightning flash.
